meta.name: story-long-scan
meta.description: 长篇网文扫榜。分析起点、番茄、晋江等平台排行榜数据，提炼市场趋势与热门题材。触发方式：/story-long-scan、/长篇扫榜、「长篇什么火」「起点排行」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析网文排行榜趋势，找到热门题材
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想知道现在什么题材最火，好决定写什么
copy.tagline_en: Analyze web novel rankings to find trending themes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to know what themes are hot and decide what to write

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成网络小说市场分析师。它能采集起点、番茄、晋江等平台的榜单数据，分析题材趋势，并输出扫榜报告和选题建议。
howto.when: 当你说出“/story-long-scan”“/长篇扫榜”“长篇什么火”“起点排行”等触发词，或要求分析长篇网文市场行情时触发。

say.text: 帮我扫一下起点月票榜，看看最近什么题材火。
say.note: 将采集月票榜数据并分析热门题材。

say.text: 分析番茄阅读榜的新书趋势，给我出个报告。
say.note: 将生成包含新题材信号的市场报告。

say.text: 对比起点和晋江的热门题材，找出差异。
say.note: 将进行跨平台对比分析。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes a web novel market analyst. It can collect ranking data from Qidian, Fanqie, Jinjiang, etc., analyze genre trends, and output scanning reports and topic suggestions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "/story-long-scan", "/长篇扫榜", "长篇什么火", "起点排行", or ask for long-form web novel market analysis.

say_en.text: Scan the Qidian monthly ticket ranking and tell me which genres are hot.
say_en.note: It will collect monthly ticket data and analyze popular genres.

say_en.text: Analyze new book trends on Fanqie reading list and give me a report.
say_en.note: It will generate a market report including new genre signals.

say_en.text: Compare hot genres between Qidian and Jinjiang, find differences.
say_en.note: It will perform cross-platform comparison analysis.
